chosen.why: Chosen by measurement on the baked recording beside the ember family in one run: every column inside ember's range (200 Hz-2 kHz 36.3 % and 300 Hz-4 kHz 31.7 %, band shares are held to a lowest only; 0.1 % above 6 kHz; tonal mid 87 %, flatness 0.01, 3.43 held-note changes a second, tempo wander 0.01 %, 0 clipped runs after the -3.5 dB trim (the old Theatre: 77), wobble 2.4 / detune 2.6 cents, 4.8 short gaps a minute, the opening pattern repeats for 2.4 s, 0.0 % of held notes outside D minor); a 62.4 s loop (26 bars at 100.0 bpm) with cut context 0.926, rhythm r 0.96 against 0.46 a bar later, spectrum cosine 0.92, wrap +1.9 / +2.0 / +3.0 dB over 250 ms / 1 s / 2 s (p30 / p64 / p96 of the loop's own steps), 97.6 % of its pitched energy on D minor (the old Theatre 90.9 %), and the drums stem 31.2 dB under the mix in 300 Hz-4 kHz (-26.9 dB in its loudest 250 ms, none of the windows within 6 dB): the pulse is carried by plucked bass and pizzicato rather than drums. 3.5 dB quieter than the themes' level (-17.0 LUFS) because the master is peaky. Best of ten renders of four briefs.
